principle.name: Navigation Rule Compliance
principle.description: All plans must comply with the navigation rules defined in plans/plan-navigation-rules.md
principle.rationale: Ensures consistency and maintainability across all project plans

example.good: Follow the template with all required sections
example.bad: Omitting dependencies or test coverage sections

convention.rule: Every plan must include Purpose, Scope, Entry Points, Planned Changes, Test Coverage, Dependencies, and Obsolete sections

examples.good: Purpose clearly states what changes and why

convention.rule: Hard and soft dependencies must be explicitly stated
convention.template:
## Dependencies ### Hard Dependencies - depends on: [other-plan.md] - blocks: [other-plan.md]
### Soft Dependencies - should be reviewed after: [other-plan.md]

pitfall.description: Creating plans without considering existing dependencies
pitfall.why_problematic: Can lead to conflicts and inconsistent execution order
pitfall.correct_approach: Always check existing plans and navigation rules before creating new ones

category.name: before_completion
category.item: Ensure all architectural invariants are maintained
Check that obsolete items are identified
